faqs.question: What are the free tourist spots in Baguio?
faqs.answer: Burnham Park, Camp John Hay and Session Road cost nothing to enter. Mines View Park starts at around ₱20, so a full day of sights can cost less than lunch.

faqs.question: When does the Baguio night market open?
faqs.answer: The ukay stalls on Harrison Road beside Burnham Park open at around 9 PM. Come right at opening for first dibs and a smaller crowd.

title: Things to Do in Cebu City: Tourist Spots, Ranked

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Fly into Mactan-Cebu International Airport, then around 30 to 60 minutes by car to the city, depending on traffic.

faqs.question: What can you do in Cebu City in one day?
faqs.answer: Start downtown at the Basilica Minore del Santo Niño and the Yap-San Diego Ancestral House, eat lechon for lunch, then head up to Temple of Leah and Tops Lookout for the late-afternoon view.

intro: El Nido is all about the water. Book one island-hopping tour, keep a day for the beaches and end every evening at sunset.
title: Things to Do in El Nido, Palawan: Tours, Beaches, Sunsets

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Fly direct to El Nido, or fly to Puerto Princesa and ride a van north for around 5 to 6 hours.

faqs.question: Which El Nido island-hopping tour should I pick?
faqs.answer: Tour A is the lagoon tour, with the Big and Small Lagoons. Tour C is the beach tour, with Hidden Beach, Secret Beach and Matinloc Shrine. If you only have one day, pick the one that matches what you came for.

label: Things to Do in Boracay
description: Things to do in Boracay beyond White Beach: paraw sailing at sunset, Puka Shell Beach, quiet Diniwid, kitesurfing on Bulabog and Willy's Rock.
intro: Boracay is more than one beach. These picks fill your days between swims, from sunset sails to the quieter coves.
title: Things to Do in Boracay Beyond White Beach

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Fly to Caticlan or Kalibo, then take the short boat ride from Caticlan Jetty Port to the island.

faqs.question: How long is a paraw sailing ride in Boracay?
faqs.answer: Rides usually last 30 minutes to an hour. Sunset slots go first, so book ahead or pick a boat on the beach early.

label: Things to Do in Tagaytay
description: Pasyalan sa Tagaytay: Sky Ranch and the Sky Eye, Picnic Grove and People's Park in the Sky, an easy day trip from Manila with budgets per head.
intro: Tagaytay is the classic day trip south of Manila. Come for the cool air and the Taal view, ride the Sky Eye at sunset, then stay for a long dinner on the ridge.
title: Pasyalan sa Tagaytay: Things to Do and Taal Views

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Around 2 hours from Manila by car, more on weekends. Nasugbu-bound buses from PITX and Pasay pass through Tagaytay.

faqs.question: Can you do Tagaytay as a day trip from Manila?
faqs.answer: Yes. Leave early, spend the afternoon at Picnic Grove or Sky Ranch, ride the Sky Eye at sunset and have dinner on the ridge before driving back.

label: Things to Do in Siargao
description: Things to do in Siargao: Cloud 9, Magpupungko rock pools, Maasin River and the coconut road, with tips on tides and the best time to go.
intro: Siargao runs on surf time. Check the tide for the rock pools, rent a scooter and let the island set the pace.
title: Things to Do in Siargao: Tourist Spots and Tide Tips

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Fly into Siargao (Sayak) Airport, then around 30 to 45 minutes by van or scooter to General Luna.

faqs.question: When should I visit Magpupungko Rock Pools?
faqs.answer: Go at low tide, when the pools are exposed and calm. Check the tide chart the day before and plan the rest of the day around it.

label: Things to Do in Coron
description: Things to do in Coron: Kayangan and Barracuda lakes, Twin Lagoon, island escapades, the Mt. Tapyas sunset and Maquinit Hot Spring, with prices.
intro: Coron has some of the clearest water in the country. Plan around one or two island tours and keep a lazy day for the town.
title: Things to Do in Coron: Lakes, Lagoons and Island Tours

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Fly into Busuanga (Francisco B. Reyes Airport), then around 30 to 40 minutes by van to Coron town.

label: Things to Do in Vigan
description: Vigan tourist spots: Calle Crisologo, the Plaza Salcedo dancing fountain and Syquia Mansion, best walked in the cool evening, with budgets per head.
intro: Vigan is a Spanish-era town you can still walk through. Come late afternoon, eat empanada and stay for the fountain show.
title: Vigan Tourist Spots: Things to Do in the Heritage City

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Around 8 to 10 hours by bus from Manila, or fly to Laoag and drive around 2 hours south.

faqs.question: Is Vigan a UNESCO World Heritage Site?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Historic Town of Vigan has been on the UNESCO World Heritage List since 1999, and Calle Crisologo is its best-known street.

label: Things to Do in Sagada
description: Things to do in Sagada: Kiltepan sunrise, Sumaguing Cave, Bomod-ok Falls and lemon pie, with guide fees and the best time to go.
intro: Sagada is cold, quiet and worth the long ride. Wake up for the sunrise, hike to the falls and warm up with pie.
title: Things to Do in Sagada: Sunrise, Caves and Lemon Pie

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Around 12 hours by overnight bus from Manila, or around 5 to 6 hours by bus or van from Baguio.

faqs.question: Is the sea of clouds at Kiltepan guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. Clouds depend on the weather, so they are never guaranteed, but the sunrise over the Cordillera ridges is worth the early alarm either way. Weekdays are less crowded.

faqs.question: What is the easiest day trip from Manila?
faqs.answer: Tagaytay and Rizal are the closest: Tagaytay for the Taal view and a long lunch, Rizal for Masungi Georeserve (reservation only) and Pintô Art Museum in Antipolo.

label: Things to Do in Bohol
description: Things to do in Bohol: the Chocolate Hills, tarsiers in Corella, the Loboc River, Balicasag snorkeling and Alona Beach, with budgets per head.
intro: Bohol rewards a road trip. Do the countryside loop for the Chocolate Hills, the tarsiers in Corella and lunch on the Loboc River, then give Panglao a full day for Balicasag and Alona Beach.
title: Things to Do in Bohol: Countryside Loop and Panglao

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Fly into Bohol-Panglao International Airport, or take a fast ferry from Cebu to Tagbilaran, around 2 hours.

faqs.question: How do I see tarsiers in Bohol responsibly?
faqs.answer: Go to the Philippine Tarsier Sanctuary in Corella, where they live in natural forest. Talk softly, use no flash and never touch them. Skip roadside cages.

label: Things to Do in Palawan

intro: Palawan is three trips in one: El Nido's lagoons, Coron's lakes and Puerto Princesa's Underground River. Pick one base, or two if you have a week, because the trip between them takes most of a day.
title: Things to Do in Palawan: El Nido, Coron, Puerto Princesa

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Fly into Puerto Princesa, El Nido or Busuanga (for Coron). Moving between them takes most of a day, so pick one or two bases.

intro: Come for the San Juan surf, stay for the rest of La Union. Hike to Tangadan Falls, then cool down with halo-halo in San Fernando before the climb to Ma-Cho Temple.
title: Things to Do in La Union Beyond the Surf

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Around 5 to 6 hours by bus from Cubao or Pasay to San Juan. Tangadan Falls is a short drive inland from San Juan.

label: Things to Do in Batangas

intro: Batangas is Manila's closest beach-and-mountain fix. Dive Anilao, sail out to Fortune Island, swim at Laiya, walk Taal's ancestral houses and save a dry-season morning for Mount Batulao.
title: Pasyalan sa Batangas: Beaches, Dives and Day Hikes

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Around 2 to 3 hours from Manila by car via SLEX and the STAR Tollway, depending on where you are headed.

label: Things to Do in Cebu
title: Cebu Tourist Spots: Things to Do from City to South
keywords: things to do in cebu philippines
description: Tourist spots in Cebu, ranked: Kawasan Falls, the Moalboal sardine run, Sumilon sandbar, Temple of Leah and lechon stops, with budgets per head.
intro: Cebu is two trips in one. Give the city a day for the Santo Niño basilica, Temple of Leah and lechon, then head south for Kawasan Falls, the Moalboal sardine run and the Sumilon sandbar off Oslob.

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Fly into Mactan-Cebu International Airport. South Cebu towns like Moalboal and Oslob are around 3 to 4 hours by bus from the Cebu South Bus Terminal.

faqs.question: How many days do you need for Cebu?
faqs.answer: Plan at least three: one for Cebu City and the Busay hills, one for Moalboal and Kawasan Falls, and one for Oslob and Sumilon Island in the far south.

label: Things to Do in Ilocos Norte
title: Things to Do in Ilocos Norte: Tourist Spots, Ranked
keywords: things to do in ilocos norte
description: Ilocos Norte tourist spots: Paoay Church, the Bangui windmills, Kapurpurawan, Cape Bojeador Lighthouse and the beaches of Pagudpud, with budgets.
intro: Ilocos Norte is a road trip up the coast. See Paoay Church and Malacañang of the North around Paoay Lake, then drive north past Kapurpurawan, Cape Bojeador and the Bangui windmills to the white sand of Pagudpud.

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Fly into Laoag International Airport, or ride a bus from Manila for around 9 to 10 hours. Rent a car or van to cover the coast.

faqs.question: Is Paoay Church a UNESCO World Heritage Site?
faqs.answer: Yes. Paoay Church is one of the four Baroque Churches of the Philippines on the UNESCO World Heritage List, famous for its 24 massive buttresses.

label: Things to Do in Batanes
title: Batanes Tourist Spots: Things to Do in Batan and Sabtang
description: Batanes tourist spots: Vayang Rolling Hills, Marlboro Country, Basco Lighthouse at sunset, Valugan Boulder Beach and Sabtang's stone houses.
intro: Batanes is all wind, wide hills and stone houses. Split it into a North Batan day for Vayang and the Basco Lighthouse sunset, a South Batan day for Marlboro Country, and a boat day to Sabtang.

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Fly into Basco Airport from Manila or Clark. Tours around Batan go by van, tricycle or bike; Sabtang is a faluwa boat ride from Ivana Port.

faqs.question: Can you swim at Valugan Boulder Beach?
faqs.answer: No. Valugan faces the open Pacific, the waves are strong and the shore is all boulders, so it is a look-only beach. Come for the sunrise and the sound of the rocks.

label: Where to Eat in Makati
keywords: where to eat in makati for dinner
description: Where to eat in Makati: Michelin-starred Toyo Eatery, Helm, Hapag, Celera, Inatô and Kása Palma, plus dinner in the old Nielson Tower at Blackbird.
intro: Makati is where the Michelin stars cluster. Save up for a tasting menu at Helm, Toyo Eatery or Hapag, or book Blackbird for dinner inside the 1937 Nielson Tower in Ayala Triangle.

faqs.question: Which Makati restaurants have Michelin stars?
faqs.answer: Helm by Josh Boutwood has two stars. Toyo Eatery, Hapag, Celera, Inatô and Kása Palma each have one. Blackbird at the Nielson Tower is also in the Michelin Guide.

label: Pasyalan sa Rizal
title: Pasyalan sa Rizal: Day Trips near Manila
description: Pasyalan sa Rizal: Masungi Georeserve, Pintô Art Museum, Treasure Mountain sunrises, Daranak Falls and the Angono petroglyphs.
intro: Rizal is the closest escape from the metro. Book a Masungi trail, catch the sunrise at Treasure Mountain in Tanay, swim at Daranak Falls, or spend a slow afternoon at Pintô Art Museum in Antipolo.

quickAnswer.gettingThere: Around 1 to 2 hours by car from Metro Manila via Marcos Highway or Ortigas Avenue Extension, depending on the stop.

faqs.question: Do I need a reservation for Masungi Georeserve?
faqs.answer: Yes. Masungi is visited by reservation only, in small guided groups, so book a trail slot before you go.
